programme.title: Take My Tumor

programme.title: Take My Tumor

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper

programme.desc: S03 E06 — Pain in the Neck John fears the large lump on his neck could become so big that it may eventually suffocate him; Shoshana is depressed because of the big growth on her forehead; Ashley hopes Dr. Lee can provide some relief from her three painful skin conditions.
programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper

programme.desc: S11 E02 — Latonya's Journey Latonya found the man she wants to marry; the only problem is that, at almost 700 pounds, she can't walk down the aisle; Latonya doesn't want to give up the food that she's used to, but she may do it for love.
programme.title: My 600-Lb. Life

programme.title: My 600-Lb. Life

programme.title: Most Extreme Humans

programme.title: Most Extreme Humans

programme.title: Most Extreme Humans

programme.title: ER: Caught on Camera

programme.title: ER: Caught on Camera

programme.desc: S01 E07 — Glass Table + No Pants = ER Pimple popping can be deadly; a stroke tries to take her husband, so she locks in to save his life; an influencer with something eating her eye; a video game leads to an impaled buttock; a man run over by a train wakes up a month later with no legs.
programme.title: ER: Caught on Camera
